args.title: Parse CSV header line with splitFields to support quoted column names
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Use splitFields instead of split(",") when parsing the CSV header line so that quoted column headers are properly unquoted and cleaned up, fixing row shape validation errors when headers have quotes.
